notes.title: Looped is also a book!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
 Hello Loopers! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826059/b0d8f28686eb679871bb8c3849724cd99f356061.png

It’s no secret that “Looped” is an interactive story based on a short film named “Looped,” but it is lesser known that the film, in turn, is based on a short story called “Loop,” published in the book Ouvertyr och andra sagor för nästan vuxna, written by Thomas Costa Freté in 2022. The book can be found at various bookstores online, but if you don’t speak Swedish, maybe it’s better to go with the game ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826059/c0ea5233cf27f80937b2141537cb839c130338c5.png

The book, on the other hand, has more stories with the characters and also features a bunch of illustrations. Fun fact: later this week, both the short film AND the game will participate at the BLON Animation and Games Festival in Klaipėda, Lithuania. Come by and say hi! :) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826059/3e4ec152e11df2ba3ebe2803d6fd0e9c911ddc74.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826059/30f58b5389a5ea24b637ada7d76055f4b4ff05d6.png

notes.title: Looped ready for Steam Deck!
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
 Hello Steam Deck! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826059/16adb814f556073d2a14ccf35e94625c5d3a3e44.png

We are happy to share that the game works great on Steam Deck! We even recommend running it on Steam Deck, where you can use touch or the stick and buttons as you please. You can already test it out with the demo, which you can find on the store page. We are also preparing to join Steam Next Fest, just around the corner. See you there :-)

notes.title: Looped Carnival Shooting Game
notes.content:
[hr][/hr]
 This is our first update about the game! 

We feel so excited and happy to work with Looped. We are learning how to update and share what's going on! I didn't know marketing was so much of game development. OMG!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826059/cddc45c8d1f6d61c2b9639ea546c86ac96064de6.gif

Atm we are working on the shooting game you will encounter in the Carnival. Carnival is for love couples, so of course we need to take a trip there. It might seem like a quick task to make a shooting game like this, but there is much more to it. What if you lose? Will there be different difficult levels? We will see, now it's shooting time!
